title: Ulyana and the Cover
author: Sable Fairweather
blurb: Juniper Pemberton, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
